# Hypothetical Therapy Session Statements

## Client Background:
**Sarah Chen, 34**, a former marketing director who was laid off six months ago from a tech startup. She's going through a divorce initiated by her husband of 8 years, recently moved from their shared home in the suburbs to a small downtown apartment, and has been estranged from her younger sister since their mother's death two years ago. She has a 6-year-old daughter, Emma, who now lives primarily with her ex. Sarah was once an avid runner and painter but has abandoned both hobbies. She's been isolating from friends and struggling with insomnia.

## 100 Client Statements:

1. "I can't remember the last time I slept through the entire night without waking up in a panic."

2. "Every time I drop Emma off at my ex's house, I feel like I'm failing as a mother."

3. "I used to be the person everyone came to for advice at work, and now I can't even decide what to eat for breakfast."

4. "My apartment feels like a temporary holding cell, not a home."

5. "I keep replaying the moment my boss called me into her office over and over in my head."

6. "Sometimes I sit in my car in the parking lot for twenty minutes before coming to these sessions, wondering if I should just drive away."

7. "My sister posted pictures of her kids at Mom's grave last week, and she didn't even tell me she was visiting."

8. "I've sent out forty-seven job applications and gotten three interviews, all rejections."

9. "The silence in my apartment at night is deafening."

10. "I used to go running every morning at 6 AM, rain or shine. Now my running shoes are still in a box from the move."

11. "Emma asked me yesterday why I'm always so tired, and I didn't know what to say to her."

12. "I can feel my heart racing right now, just sitting here talking to you."

13. "My ex has already introduced Emma to his new girlfriend, and they've only been dating for two months."

14. "I haven't painted anything since before Mom died, and I used to paint every weekend."

15. "The thought of going to a networking event makes me want to throw up."

16. "I've been lying to my friends, telling them I'm too busy to meet up, but really I just can't face them."

17. "I'm 34 years old and I'm living like a college student again, and not in a good way."

18. "Every time my phone buzzes, my chest tightens because I assume it's bad news."

19. "I burned dinner last night because I was just staring at the wall and forgot I was cooking."

20. "My dad keeps asking me to come visit, but I can't handle his pity right now."

21. "I went to the grocery store yesterday and had a panic attack in the cereal aisle."

22. "The medication you prescribed is helping a little, but I still feel like I'm underwater."

23. "I haven't told anyone this, but I've been having thoughts about just disappearing somewhere."

24. "My old coworkers sometimes text me, but I don't respond because I'm embarrassed about my situation."

25. "I feel like everyone at Emma's school is judging me for the divorce."

26. "I've gained fifteen pounds since the layoff, and none of my work clothes fit anymore."

27. "Sometimes I wonder if Emma would be better off if I wasn't so broken right now."

28. "I can't stop checking LinkedIn to see if my former colleagues are talking about me."

29. "The highlight of my day is when Emma video calls me before bed, and that's only ten minutes."

30. "I keep having this recurring dream where I'm late for an important meeting and I can't find the room."

31. "My ex told me I should 'get my act together' when I was five minutes late for pickup last week."

32. "I've been taking two-hour naps in the afternoon just to escape being awake."

33. "I used to be so organized, and now I can't keep track of anything—I missed paying my electric bill last month."

34. "My hands shake when I'm trying to fill out job applications now."

35. "I saw my sister at Mom's lawyer's office for the estate stuff, and we didn't even speak to each other."

36. "The idea of starting over at a new company at my age terrifies me."

37. "I keep refreshing my email every five minutes hoping for a job offer, and then feeling crushed when there's nothing."

38. "Emma told me she likes her dad's girlfriend's cooking better than mine."

39. "I haven't been to the gym in six months, and I used to be there five days a week."

40. "Sometimes I just sit on my couch and cry for no specific reason."

41. "My wedding photos are still in boxes in my closet, and I can't bring myself to look at them or throw them away."

42. "I feel guilty every time I spend money on anything, even groceries."

43. "My best friend from college is getting married next month, and I told her I can't make it because I can't afford it, but really I just can't face being happy for her right now."

44. "I've been grinding my teeth so badly that my dentist wants me to get a night guard."

45. "The thought of dating again makes me feel physically ill."

46. "I can't concentrate long enough to read even a single article anymore, and I used to read two books a month."

47. "My severance package runs out in two months, and I'm terrified."

48. "Sometimes I'm jealous of Emma because she doesn't fully understand how bad things are."

49. "I've been avoiding my mother-in-law's calls because I know she blames me for the divorce."

50. "The last time I felt genuinely happy was probably two years ago at Emma's birthday party."

51. "I keep having fantasies about my old life, like it was all just a bad dream."

52. "My apartment building has a community art room, but I walk past it every day without going in."

53. "I've started drinking wine alone at night, more than I used to."

54. "My ex seems to be doing absolutely fine with all of this, and that makes me feel even worse."

55. "I can't shake the feeling that I deserved to be laid off, like they saw something in me that was broken."

56. "Emma asked me why we can't live in our old house anymore, and I just started crying."

57. "I've been canceling therapy appointments in my head all week, but then I force myself to come."

58. "My credit card debt is piling up, and I feel paralyzed about dealing with it."

59. "Sometimes I imagine what it would be like if I just never woke up."

60. "I haven't worn makeup in weeks because what's the point?"

61. "My younger cousin just got promoted to senior manager, and I had to mute her on social media because I couldn't handle it."

62. "I feel like I'm watching my life fall apart from outside my body."

63. "The mediator for the divorce keeps pushing me to make decisions, and I just freeze up."

64. "I've been screening all my calls, even from people who are trying to help."

65. "My ex accused me of being unstable in front of Emma, and now I'm terrified he'll use that in custody discussions."

66. "I can't tell if this hopeless feeling will ever go away or if this is just my life now."

67. "I've been eating cereal for dinner most nights because I don't have the energy to cook."

68. "The woman who took my position at the company just accepted the role, and I saw it on LinkedIn."

69. "I'm supposed to be looking for jobs right now, but instead I'm just sitting here with you, feeling like a failure."

70. "My sister inherited Mom's engagement ring, and I got her recipe box, and I'm still angry about it."

71. "I've been having chest pains, but I'm pretty sure it's just anxiety, so I haven't gone to the doctor."

72. "Emma's teacher emailed me about a parent-teacher conference, and I panicked and haven't responded yet."

73. "I keep comparing myself to who I was a year ago, and I don't recognize myself anymore."

74. "My ex's new girlfriend is younger, thinner, and apparently great with Emma, and I feel like I'm being replaced."

75. "I've been lying awake at 3 AM doing mental math about how long my savings will last."

76. "Sometimes I get angry at Mom for dying and leaving me to deal with everything alone."

77. "I've stopped posting on social media because I don't want people to see how far I've fallen."

78. "The headhunter I was working with stopped returning my emails."

79. "I feel like I'm burdening you with all of this, and you probably have clients with real problems."

80. "My hands were shaking so badly at the last interview that I could barely hold the pen to take notes."

81. "I've been having intrusive thoughts about the car accident I saw last year, and I don't know why it's coming up now."

82. "Emma told me she wants to live with Daddy full-time, and I felt like my heart stopped."

83. "I can't tell if I'm sad about losing my marriage or just sad about failing."

84. "My apartment lease is up in six months, and I don't know if I'll be able to afford to renew it."

85. "I've been parking outside my old house sometimes, just sitting there looking at it."

86. "The antidepressants are helping with the crying, but I still feel empty inside."

87. "I got rejected from a job I was overqualified for, and the person they hired has half my experience."

88. "My college roommate keeps inviting me to girls' weekends, and I keep making excuses."

89. "I feel like I'm drowning and everyone else is just walking by on the shore."

90. "My ex is taking Emma on a vacation to Disney World next month, and I can barely afford to take her to the movies."

91. "I've been having nightmares about showing up to work naked or unprepared."

92. "The silence between my sister and me feels permanent now, and I don't know how to fix it."

93. "I'm terrified that this is who I am now—just this anxious, depressed shell of a person."

94. "Emma drew a picture of our family at school, and I wasn't in it."

95. "I've been googling my symptoms at night, and that's making everything worse."

96. "My neighbor invited me to a barbecue, and I lied and said I had plans."

97. "I keep thinking about all the warning signs I ignored about my marriage and my job, and I feel stupid."

98. "Sometimes I wonder if I'm even capable of being happy again."

99. "I've been setting my alarm to go running in the morning, and then hitting snooze for two hours."

100. "I'm here today because some small part of me still has hope, but I'm not sure how long that will last."
